title: Repair app build/runtime issues and restore correct role-based dashboards

requirements.text: Make the app compile and run without errors by identifying and fixing any frontend build-time or runtime crashes caused by missing/empty React component modules, missing exports, or unsafe calls on optional values (e.g., calling methods on optional blob references).
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend` builds successfully with TypeScript with no missing-module or missing-export errors.
App loads to the Landing Page when logged out and does not crash when logged in/out.
Any UI that reads optional blob fields (e.g., company logo/banner, user profile picture) guards against absent values and does not throw at runtime.

requirements.text: Fix the authenticated routing so the correct dashboard is shown based on the signed-in user’s role: candidate users see CandidateDashboard, employer users see EmployerDashboard, and admins see AdminDashboard (when admin detection is available).
acceptanceCriteria: When a signed-in user has role `#candidate`, the Candidate Dashboard is shown after profile setup.
When a signed-in user has role `#employer`, the Employer Dashboard is shown after profile setup.
When the signed-in user is an admin, the Admin Dashboard is shown (or a clear fallback is used if admin status cannot be determined).

requirements.text: Ensure backend methods used by the frontend’s query/mutation hooks exist and match the generated candid interface (in particular: user profile fetch/save/customization, company pages list retrieval if referenced, and admin detection if referenced). Add missing backend functions or adjust frontend usage so calls do not fail at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: All frontend React Query hooks invoked by default app flows (Landing Page, Header, Profile Setup, dashboards) have corresponding backend actor methods and do not fail due to missing canister methods.
Logged-in flow can successfully fetch `getCallerUserProfile()` and complete profile setup/customization without trapping due to absent methods.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components).
Do not edit frontend immutable hook entry files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose around them instead).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo changes if state schema changes are required.
nonGoals: Implementing the placeholder/empty tabs’ full product functionality (analytics, messaging, interviews, assessments, etc.).
Adding third-party auth providers or external databases.
